_doc: Formula v2 class anchors (BALANCE_PIPELINE.md §5, DESIGN §12 second iteration). Each class prices by normalized deviation from its anchor: Cost = cost0 * (O/O0 + P/P0 + Q/Q0) / 3 — exact at the anchor. Anchors are MAINTAINER picks, validated by tools/balance/fit_class.py before sign-off. reveals_shroud (maintainer 2026-07-22) = baseline range floored to 5000 for scout/closecombat/melee. Infantry anchors locked 2026-07-22 (DPS/cost provisional, tested in-game later). Classes without an entry keep the global Tiger formula.

Round-number fix (maintainer 2026-07-22): reload 75->70 lands DPS on 250 (4000x5/70x.875=250.0) with damage staying 2000+2000 on the grid, NO FP multiplier. VERIFIER asianalliance_fanatic 2x HP + 2x bursts (burst10, same ReloadDelay 70) @ 500 (4000x10/70x.875=500.0, identity exact). Band [2500,4500). All members use SmallArms+Chaingun; SoundVolume = 1/burst; BurstDelays 0; damage split 2000+2000 per shot in 2000-steps. Tier factor 0.75=T3.

melee.comment: MELEE RANGE IS PRICED like every other class (maintainer 2026-07-22 CORRECTION; the earlier 'unpriced/fixed-ratio-1' note in FORMULA_V2 was WRONG and nobody authored it). Ranges cluster 1250-1750; bigger units get more reach (grunt > footman) so it prices normally, just with small spread. Baseline asianalliance_alligator (SwordWeapon) + verifier yuri_brute, BOTH scaled to a common in-between speed 90; anchor range 1500 = band middle [1250,1750] (alligator was 108, brute 80). Verifier target = 54000 HP / 90 speed / 1500 range / 600 DPS / 700 cost (2xHP, 2xDPS, same speed+range, 2.5x cost). cost0=280 chosen so the WC/SC-side verifier lands on 700 (a multiple of 20 — WC/SC power = Cost/20).

special_forces.comment: LIVING BASELINE japan_imperialscoutsman 15000/50/6000, DPS 240 (baseline DOUBLED from 120, maintainer 2026-07-22). Weapon = SmallArms+Chaingun+Railgun-AP, each warhead 4000 => SUM 12000 @ reload 50 => DPS 240 (WC 1.0), air-capable, bullet projectile = 200. Fragile long-range versatile anti-air/anti-armor specialist (contrast the 50000-HP closecombat brawler). Band 5500-6500 (r0 6000). Air is the CLASS trait, never a per-unit special. ^SpecialForcesInfantryTemplate. NOTE: current yaml still holds the MAX-era 12000-per-warhead build (SUM 36000, 3x hot); the closecombat+SF reconversion pass re-splits it to 4000x3.
special_forces.dps_convention: light+medium+heavy warhead triad SUMMED (maintainer SUM law 2026-07-22): each warhead carries its own damage and the weapon's effective damage is their sum (SA+Chaingun+Railgun on the baseline; CannonAP+Flak+Laser or SA+Chaingun+Laser on members), WC 1.0. *ExtraDamage / *Percentage / *FriendlyFire warheads are EXCLUDED from the sum. Never set every warhead equal to the intended total.
special_forces.verifier_comment: T1 (no tech penalty) clean tripwire: schwarzermond_lunarsoldier 30000/50/6000 SA+Chaingun+Laser each warhead 8000 => SUM 24000 @ 50 => DPS 480 (2x HP + 2x DPS, same rng/spd) = 500.00 exact. Makes SM basic infantry strong on purpose (in-game test flagged). NOTE: td_nod_lasertrooper is NOT the verifier - it is Tier 4 (temple prime, 0.5x factor), re-priced as a 4x/4x=750 heavy SF trooper (each warhead 16000 => SUM 48000 => DPS 960).

support.comment: SUPPORT = ABILITY-PRICED (price = baseline + Sum of special-K per ability, FORMULA_V2 3b). HP is PER-UNIT (weak support ~5000; strong casters keep their high HP to fight). No combat verifier. Members: medics, mechanics, engineers, casters, spies, mind-control, hackers.
